CustomField.description: When someone first acted on this work order. Blank means Untouched. Stamped automatically by the Work Order Touch Sync before-save flow the first time Status leaves New; drives Is_Untouched__c and the Untouched KPI. Replaces First_Touched_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time of the first action on this work order. Stamped automatically when Status first leaves New - leave it blank; a blank value is what marks the work order Untouched.
CustomField.label: First Touched DateTime
